thread:
Alex K: Quick check — vendor-x just pinged: 48x RTX A500s available in APAC with ~28-35 day lead time. Do we want to lock any for the next Dedicated pool? PO deadline EOW.

Priya S: How many GPUs do we actually still need for Q2 planned rollouts? Last forecast had ~60 demand, committed 38 so far, so gap ~22. Can someone confirm numbers? @Jonas M?

Jonas M: Confirmed from infra runbook: committed = 38 (dedicated + experiments), planned burst reserve = 8. So net gap 14–24 depending on safety buffer. Also: A500 perf is ~0.6x A100 for fp16, but for int8/quantized LLMs it's fine. Need to decide mix.

procurement-bot: Inventory snapshot (vendor-x/apac): available=48 A500, available_a100=0, lead_time=28-35d, price_delta=+3% vs last quote. Reservation cutoff=2029-05-02. PO template: https://vendor-x.example.com/po/form (token required).

Mei L: Proposal: buy 24 A500s for Dedicated pool (improves throughput for medium-size models) + keep 8 as hot-burst/spare. That covers the gap and keeps runway for tests. Is Finance ok with ~24k/mo estimate? (ballpark)

Carlos R: I can fast-track a finance pre-approval for up to $30k/mo if we define intended usage and allocation tags. Also recommend we request 2 vendor test nodes first to validate runtime images before full order.

Alex K: Sounds reasonable. Action items: 1) Procure 2 test A500s from vendor (Jonas) 2) Reserve 24 for Dedicated, 8 for burst + 16 optional hold? wait — math off. Let's be explicit: reserve 32 total (24 pool + 8 burst). That leaves 16 unreserved. Do we want to reserve fewer?

Priya S: Given lead time, I'd prefer reserving 30 (24 pool + 6 burst) and keep vendor relationship for rest. That keeps spend lower. Vote: 30 = +1 from me.

Jonas M: +1 to 30. I'll spin up 2 test nodes in vendor staging and run our container image; will post perf numbers here. Quick check command I'll run:
```
ssh vendor-test-01 sudo ./run_inference_bench.sh --model redwood-opt-7b --batch 1 --seq 1024
```
I'll share logs if anything flaky (drivers, cuda, mmap).

Carlos R: I'll open a PR to procurement with target qty=30, split (24/6) and tag allocations. Also pinging finance now.

procurement-bot: Created draft PO #PX-4821 (qty=30 A500) — status=draft, hold-until=2029-05-02. Link: https://procurement.internal/PO/PX-4821

Alex K: Great — thanks all. We'll reconvene if vendor changes availability. If test nodes show issues, pause full PO.

Mei L: Noted. I'll update the Dedicated capacity plan doc with provisional numbers and expected latency targets.

Priya S: Thanks — can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when they actually approve the PO so Carlos can finalize?

Jonas M: :white_check_mark:

Carlos R: :white_check_mark:

Mei L: :white_check_mark:

Alex K: :white_check_mark:

procurement-bot: PO PX-4821 moved to awaiting-approval."
